title: Srinagar, Leh & Manali (10N/11D)
reportingPoint: The trip starts in Srinagar: arrive on Day 1 and check in to the hotel. Final reporting details are shared once your booking is confirmed. It ends in Delhi or Chandigarh after the overnight journey from Manali.
highlights: Zoji La, Drass and the Kargil War Memorial area
Kargil to Leh via Fotu La and Lamayuru, with Magnetic Hill and the Hall of Fame
Khardung La (18,380 ft), Diskit Monastery and the Hunder dunes
Turtuk, the last village on the Indo-Pak border
The Leh-Manali highway via Tanglang La, the Gata Loops, Sarchu, Baralacha La and the Atal Tunnel
overview:
The great crossing in reverse: Zoji La to Kargil, Fotu La to Leh, Khardung La, Nubra and Turtuk, Pangong Tso, then the Leh-Manali highway via Sarchu, by bike or by car. It is a **10 Nights / 11 Days** fixed-departure group trip that starts in Srinagar and ends in Delhi or Chandigarh after the overnight journey from Manali, with stays in hotels, camps and homestays and 15 meals across the trip.

Travel in a sitting coach (SIC) by Traveller or MUV, ride a Royal Enfield Himalayan solo or with a pillion, or bring your own bike. An oxygen cylinder rides in the car 24x7, with a mechanical backup vehicle and a team captain throughout. Prices start at ₹26,000 per person on triple sharing with your own bike and fuel, or ₹38,000 by SIC (5% GST extra). Reserve your seat with ₹8,000 and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. Batches run every week in the summer season, June to September, when the Leh-Manali highway is open; call us for 2027 dates.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.content:
Arrive in Srinagar and check in to the hotel.
Rest, and overnight in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Kargil
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive towards Kargil via Sonmarg and Zoji La.
Pass through Drass and the Kargil War Memorial area.
Overnight in Kargil.

itinerary.title: Kargil to Leh
itinerary.content:
Kargil to Leh via Fotu La and Lamayuru.
Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and the Hall of Fame on the way.
Overnight at the hotel in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
itinerary.content:
Ride over Khardung La to Nubra.
Visit Diskit Monastery and take a camel ride at the Hunder dunes.
Overnight at a Nubra camp.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk and Diskit
itinerary.content:
Visit Turtuk, the last village on the Indo-Pak border, then Diskit.
Back to Nubra for the night.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso
itinerary.content:
Nubra to Pangong Tso via the Shyok route.
The lake changes colour through the day.
Overnight in a lakeside cottage.

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.content:
Sunrise at Pangong, then back to Leh via Chang La.
Overnight at the hotel in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Sarchu
itinerary.content:
Leh to Sarchu over Tanglang La and the Gata Loops.
Overnight at the camp.

itinerary.title: Sarchu to Manali
itinerary.content: Sarchu to Manali via Baralacha La and the Atal Tunnel.

itinerary.content: Manali sightseeing, then the overnight journey to Delhi or Chandigarh.

faqs.q: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.a: The trip starts in Srinagar on Day 1; you make your own way there. It ends in Delhi or Chandigarh on Day 11, after the overnight journey from Manali.

faqs.q: What are the travel options and what do they cost?
faqs.a: Per person on triple sharing: sitting coach (SIC) ₹38,000, RE Himalayan with pillion ₹38,000, RE Himalayan solo rider ₹48,000, and your own bike with your own fuel ₹26,000. On the own-bike options, double occupancy is ₹3,000 per person extra. 5% GST is extra.
Summer season only, from June to September, when the Leh-Manali highway is open. Batches leave every week (the last one for example 27 September to 7 October 2027). Call us for 2027 dates.

9 nights in hotels, camps and homestays, all meals mentioned in the itinerary, bike rent for 8 days with fuel (bike option) or travel by Traveller / MUV (SIC), a mechanical and luggage backup vehicle, an oxygen cylinder 24x7, inner line permits and the Ladakh union fee, riding gear, a first-aid kit and a team captain.

5% GST, unspecified meals, room heater charges, entry and monument fees, personal expenses and tips, extra days due to weather or snow road blocks, any damage to the bike except engine damage, and costs from medical emergencies.

faqs.a: Pick your batch and option, then call or WhatsApp us on +91 88008 41209. Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹8,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and pay the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹8,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. The balance is due 24 hours before boarding, and pending payments may cancel the booking. Bookings can't be transferred.
